description:
## 1.1.0 (2026-10-11)
* Adds two patches for RailOne (org.cris.aikyam):
  * Allow screenshots - the in-app WebView (WavesActivity) no longer applies FLAG_SECURE, and the bundled
    no_screenshot plugin's own FLAG_SECURE hook is neutered, so screenshots and screen recordings work
    everywhere and stop coming out black
  * Hide screenshot detection - the plugin's MediaStore ContentObserver is never registered, so
    screenshot/screen-recording detection never becomes active
* Verified on RailOne 2.1.66 (versionCode 237), arm64, Moto Edge 50 Neo / Android 16: bundle applied to the
  original Play-signed APK with morphe-desktop, output re-disassembled and the edits confirmed, then
  installed over the previous build (same keystore, data preserved) with real screenshot content and no
  detection event in logcat.
* The four anti-tamper patches from 1.0.0 are unchanged.
